## Experience

### LANIT, Moscow — Frontend Developer (September 2022 — April 2026)

- **State Register of Medicinal Products** (11.2025 — 04.2026). React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Hook Form, React Router. Migrated from Create React App (Webpack) to Vite; built a multi-step wizard form with validation, a version diff view and a versioned tree-structured document upload component; covered business logic with Jest and React Testing Library.
- **Moscow Urban Economy Complex Control Center** (03.2025 — 10.2025). Vue 2/3, Angular 19, TypeScript, Leaflet, 2GIS, Keycloak. Built an interactive calendar scheduler, a Keycloak role-based access widget, a "Screenshot to PDF" widget, and interactive map pages with Leaflet + 2GIS layers; refactored map modules.
- **Russian Union of Motor Insurers (NSIS)** (09.2022 — 03.2025). React 17, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Webpack, Module Federation, Storybook, Jest. Cut application load time from 12 s to 1.5 s, build size from 80 MB to 50 MB, and package installation from 10 min to 30 s; upgraded Node.js 14 → 18; configured shared dependencies in Module Federation and built new microfrontends; split the UI kit into smaller packages.
